text: Clinical atmosphere. High quality product! Lots of favors to choose from (more than you see in most stores). Good people. I met the owner who is fighting hard for our rights! I want to support his work.
Nice store, courteous counselor, nice atmosphere, thank you for your work, will definitely come back again
My new favorite spot this side of the island - Great selection, quality and extremely competitive pricing for the area. Avoid other overpriced shops in on the main street and go here instead.
We are the only licensed provider on Koh Samui for the entire supply chain of medical cannabis, from beginning to end.
Affordable and close to the beach. Lots of choice, great store, highly recommended!

Unfortunately I was disappointed in this store and the operator, I do not recommend this store! There are much better quality stores on the island! Don't stop at the first one!
